en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a cobblestone market square lined with multi-story townhouses and shops. In the center distance stands a large, symmetrical town hall–style building with many windows, a clock, and a small cupola on the roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and cycle through the square. The caption at the bottom reads "Hainichen i. Sa. Markt," indicating the market square of Hainichen in Saxony, Germany.
